sections.Profile:
Players fight through scenes from AMC's The Walking Dead, clearing walkers out of the Cell Block C prison building, working the bicycle girl ramp and bashing the Well Walker toy, then loading a re-engineered crossbow that fires the ball at a shot of the player's choosing. Stern's 2025 remaster of the 2014 machine is again led by designer John Borg and builds on the ruleset he wrote with Lyman F. Sheats Jr., with new callouts from Michael Rooker and Danai Gurira.
